race.description: Tab One Pool Fillies & Mares Mdn Hcp
race.comment: TSZINSI (4) sets the mark after a solid second at this venue when resuming, beaten just over a length despite jumping awkwardly and being unwanted in the market. She has placed at her only start at the track and distance and the apprentice claim adds another practical positive second-up. WORTHTHEADMISSION (11) resumes off a Doomben trial placing and her debut fourth in a 2yo Open at Toowoomba reads well enough for this maiden, with the Sunshine Coast failure easier to excuse after she had trouble obtaining clear running. SPEED ENCORE (7) has to rebound from a plain Scone resumption, but her debut second in a 2yo F Open at Muswellbrook showed sharper closing ability and she has already placed at 1000m. CORAL (13) brings Sydney mid-week race experience for Chris Waller and has had two trials since last racing, so she has the profile to improve fresh if she returns more polished than in her first campaign.
